articles.title: FDA Actively Suppressing Vaccine Risk Evidence in Children — Deaths Already Recorded, No Action Taken
articles.summary: The FDA is sitting on evidence of serious vaccine risks in children, including deaths, despite internal recommendations to issue warnings. No regulatory action has been taken. articles.title: Vinay Prasad Unloads: Fauci Was Wrong on Every Single Pandemic Policy — And Public Health Is Still Broken

Prasad's critique extends to the structural rot inside public health institutions that enabled Fauci's unchecked authority. This is a credentialed insider naming names and refusing to stay quiet.

articles.title: Political Interference in Medicine Is Destroying Your Health Freedom — And Hospitals Are Complicit
articles.summary: Trust in hospitals and health institutions has collapsed post-COVID, and this Mercola analysis traces it directly to political meddling in clinical decision-making. The piece documents how the healthcare industry weaponized the pandemic to consolidate control over patient choices. Medical freedom is being dismantled from the inside.

articles.title: UK Doctor Forced Out of NHS After Raising Safety Concerns About Puberty Blockers — Labeled 'Transphobic' to Silence Her
articles.summary: Dr. Redvers, a GP, was subjected to a four-hour interrogation described as 'brutal' and ultimately felt forced to quit the NHS after raising legitimate clinical concerns about a trans doctor prescribing puberty blockers to under-18s. Rather than investigate the safety concern, the system turned on the whistleblower. This is exactly how institutional medicine silences dissent.

articles.title: The Sun Is Free and Has No Lobbyists — Which Is Exactly Why Medicine Ignores It
articles.summary: Mercola's analysis of suppressed light biology research makes a damning point: sunlight is one of the most therapeutically powerful exposures known to human health, yet receives no institutional support because no one profits from it. Modern lighting's biological harms — circadian disruption, mitochondrial dysfunction — are documented but buried. Follow the money, or in this case, follow its absence.

articles.title: Curcumin Selectively Kills Sarcoma Cells While Sparing Healthy Tissue — Big Pharma Has Zero Interest in Finding Out Why
articles.summary: Researchers at Wroclaw Medical University found that curcumin and four other plant compounds demonstrated meaningful anticancer activity against fibrosarcoma cells with favorable selectivity over healthy muscle cells. This kind of metabolic and natural compound research consistently fails to attract NIH funding or clinical follow-up because it threatens patentable chemotherapy revenues. The data exists — the will to pursue it does not.

articles.title: Decanoic Acid Suppresses Dangerous Inflammation and Could Reduce Steroid Dependency — So Why Isn't Anyone Talking About It?
articles.summary: A peer-reviewed study in PLOS ONE shows decanoic acid — a medium-chain fatty acid — additively suppresses IL-1β inflammatory signaling and may allow significant reduction in dexamethasone doses, a steroid with serious long-term side effects. Metabolic and dietary interventions that reduce dependence on pharmaceutical drugs are chronically underfunded and underreported. This is one more example of the body's own biochemistry being ignored in favor of synthetic drugs.

articles.title: COVID Surveillance Systemically Undercounted Cases in Poor Minority Neighborhoods — The Data Was Always Politically Shaped
articles.summary: A PLOS ONE study of Miami-Dade County reveals that passive COVID-19 surveillance systems structurally undercounted cases in low-income minority communities while affluent neighborhoods appeared to bear greater burden as testing access expanded. This confirms what critics said from day one: the official case counts were artifacts of testing infrastructure, not disease reality. Public health policy built on this corrupted data was never sound.

articles.title: Vinay Prasad Unloads: 'Fauci Was Wrong About Almost Every Single Pandemic Policy He Advanced'

This directly implicates NIH-linked researchers in the functional blueprint of SARS-CoV-2. The emails were not volunteered; they had to be dragged into the light.

articles.title: Decanoic Acid Slashes Inflammation and Could Replace High-Dose Steroids — Where's the Clinical Trial?

If a patentable drug showed this profile in macrophage models, it would be fast-tracked. Because it's a fatty acid, it sits in a journal and goes nowhere.

articles.title: Sunlight: The Essential Nutrient With No Lobbyists and a Mountain of Suppressed Evidence

Because no pharmaceutical company can profit from sunlight, the research is systematically underfunded, ignored in clinical guidelines, and buried beneath SPF marketing. The conflicts writing public health guidance on UV exposure run directly through the dermatology-pharma complex.

articles.title: Hibsago Approved With Boxed Warning — FDA Greenlit a Hepatitis B Drug That Can Cause Liver Reactions and Platelet Collapse

While the drug shows functional cure potential in roughly 1 in 5 patients off treatment, the boxed warning signals serious risks that the approving press release buries under 'breakthrough' framing. Patients deserve the full risk picture, not a marketing headline.

The population is being kept indoors and sick while sunscreen manufacturers collect billions.
